name: Castlefest
blurb: The Netherlands' fantasy festival at Castle Keukenhof in Lisse, with bands, workshops, markets and a large cosplay community.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: '5 - 8 August 2027 Castlefest' and 'The ticket sales for Castlefest 2027 will start on 1 October, at 12.00h (CEST)'.

notes: The line-up page still shows last year's acts ('Right now, you can still find the acts and information of 2026. We'll update the website in september.' / Koza Mostra, Stimmgewalt, Faun are 2026 acts), so per RESEARCH.md guests is 'none-yet' for the 2027 edition rather than announced.
